One founding engineer at The Utopia Studio built a clinical platform for surgical mentoring in three months.

Mentix began with Dr. Amyn Haji, who trains surgeons in advanced endoscopy at King’s College Hospital. He worked with the team to write the product Requirements. Software Factory turned them into Blueprints and Work Orders, with a working prototype ready in three weeks.

“When the people who hold the knowledge help write the requirements, and our stack goes in with them, the work order knows what matters and why,” says James Cannan, founding engineer at Utopia Studio.

Mentix TV can broadcast a live procedure to a room of trainees. By July, the team was running live sessions, including a masterclass at King’s.
